about: Large public downloads kept in the shared .cache/, not in git. A test may name a path with @pytest.mark.local_dataset only if it is listed here (tests/conftest.py). `uv run python scripts/fetch_download.py <path>` fetches an entry and keeps it only if its size and SHA-256 match. Each sha256 is that of the copy the tests were run against.

ESA Gaia archive TAP (gea.esac.esa.int), one ADQL query: Hipparcos, the New Reduction (van Leeuwen 2007, public.hipparcos_newreduction) joined on hip with the Hipparcos Catalogue (ESA 1997, public.hipparcos) for the 226 stars the gaia-dr3 G 12 tiles take from Hipparcos; 226 rows of CSV, fetched 2026-11-09T21:13:20Z. Data hosted in the ESA Space Science Archives are distributed under CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO, credit ESA; commercial use needs ESA's prior authorisation. Baked by scripts/bake_bright_stars_3d.py.
